title: Verify you are logged in to Obeyba before using the Tote Management API functions
summary: Before using the Tote Management API functions (e.g., “Get Tote Task”, “Resend Tote Task”, “Exchange Tote”, “Exchange Lane”) on the Obeyba Aveva API page, confirm you are logged in to Obeyba when prompted. This prevents attempting tote API actions without an authenticated session.
when_to_use: Use this pre-check when you are about to use the Obeyba “API Features for Tote Management” page to access tote API functions such as “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the Obeyba login state check and, if needed, log in so the Tote Management API functions are accessible.
access_or_tools_needed: Obeyba Aveva API page: “API Features for Tote Management”

access_required: Ability to view the Obeyba Aveva API page for Tote Management

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Obeyba Aveva API page “API Features for Tote Management” and the prompt text “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Open the “API Features for Tote Management” page in Obeyba
steps.purpose: Ensure you are on the correct Obeyba API page that contains the Tote Management API functions.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Obeyba Aveva API page labeled “API Features for Tote Management” (the page that lists functions such as “Get Tote Task”, “Resend Tote Task”, “Exchange Tote”, and “Exchange Lane”).
steps.expected_result: The Tote Management API functions list is visible on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the function names on the page, including “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show the Tote Management API functions list as expected (or you are prompted that you are not logged in).

actions.label: Open Tote Management API features page
actions.exact_action: Open the “API Features for Tote Management” page

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows the page “API Features for Tote Management” with functions including “Get Tote Task”, “Resend Tote Task”, “Exchange Tote”, and “Exchange Lane”.

steps.title: Confirm you are logged in to Obeyba when prompted
steps.purpose: Authenticate before attempting tote API actions.
steps.instruction: When you see the prompt text “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”, confirm whether you are logged in.
steps.expected_result: You are logged in to Obeyba (or you determine you are not logged in based on the prompt/state).
steps.healthy_condition: The prompt indicates you are logged in (i.e., you can proceed with the Tote Management API functions on the page).
steps.failure_condition: The prompt indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba.

actions.label: Check login prompt/state
actions.exact_action: Confirm you are logged in to Obeyba when prompted (“Are you logged in to Obeyba?”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript near this frame: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Log in to Obeyba if you are not authenticated, then return to the Tote Management API page
steps.purpose: Restore access to the Tote Management API functions after authentication.
steps.instruction: If you are not logged in, log in to Obeyba, then return to the “API Features for Tote Management” page to access the functions list.
steps.expected_result: After logging in, the Tote Management API functions list is accessible on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.
steps.healthy_condition: You can view the functions on the page (e.g., “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”).
steps.failure_condition: Even after logging in, the Tote Management API functions are still not accessible.

actions.label: Log in to Obeyba
actions.exact_action: Log in to Obeyba, then return to the “API Features for Tote Management” page

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the API functions after logging in, stop and escalate to support (no further troubleshooting steps are provided by the source).

failure_conditions: After confirming login (and logging in if needed), the Tote Management API functions are still not accessible.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot access the API functions after logging in, stop and escalate to support. The source does not provide additional troubleshooting steps.
